Subject: Vendor enrollment question — PO timestamping & credit note flow

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. As we work through the vendor enrollment form I've pulled together a couple of technical questions from our finance and billing teams that will impact how we generate invoices and any downstream credit notes for Crestline. Short version: we can support additional invoice metadata, but want to confirm exact fields/format so your AP can auto-match.

Two specific asks from your side that we heard in the call:
- PO issue timestamp: your AP wants a discrete PO "issue" timestamp (UTC preferred) attached to invoices for line-level matching and audit. Can you confirm whether you need the PO issue timestamp OR the PO approval timestamp (sometimes different) — and the expected timezone?
- Self-billing / credit notes: you mentioned Crestline sometimes requires supplier credit notes rather than buyer-issued credits. Are supplier-originated credit notes allowed if they reference the original Redwood invoice number and include VAT reclaim fields?

I've attached our Redwood AP onboarding packet (lightweight) that shows the invoice metadata we currently emit and three supported delivery mechanisms (UBL/CSV, SFTP drop with manifest, or invoice webhook).

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf (pdf)

Proposed next step: if you can send back a one-page example of your required PO fields (a sample CSV or a short screenshot of the AP matching rules), we can confirm exact mapping and turn around a test file.

Best,

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — appreciate the packet. Quick answers:
1) We need the PO issue timestamp (when the PO was created by our procurement system), not the later approval timestamp. UTC is fine. Field name in our system is PO_CREATED_AT but we can map on your side.
2) We cannot accept buyer-issued "self-bill" invoices for certain energy services due to regulatory traceability — we need supplier-originated credit notes when a refund/adjustment is required. Those credit notes must: reference the original invoice id, include the original PO number and the PO_CREATED_AT timestamp, and include VAT base + VAT reclaim indicator per line.

I've attached our vendor enrollment spreadsheet with the columns our AP expects; column names in row 1 are authoritative. Also attaching a short sample of the PO export (PO_export_sample.csv).

Attachments: Crestline_Vendor_Enrollment.xlsx (xlsx), PO_export_sample.csv (csv)

We'll need a short test (one invoice + one credit note) delivered to our SFTP so our matching rules can be validated. Do you support sending credit notes as a separate UBL document + webhook event?

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Supplier Operations
Crestline Energy

Hi Elena — thanks for the detail and the sample files. Quick summary of what we can deliver for the test: 

1) PO issue timestamp: Redwood will emit a "po_issue_ts" field (UTC ISO-8601) at invoice line level in both our UBL (cac:OrderReference/cbc:IssueDateTime) and CSV export (column: po_issue_ts). We'll populate this from your PO_export_sample when available and retain it in the invoice metadata for audit.

2) Credit note workflow: we can generate supplier-style credit notes that reference the original invoice id (invoice_number) and the original PO number. For delivery we support two options — choose one: 
   - Preferred: Generate a CreditNote as a separate UBL document and push to your SFTP inbound folder + send a webhook event (signed, with HMAC) that includes a manifest record (credit_note_id, original_invoice_id, po_number, po_issue_ts).
   - Alternative: Generate a PDF credit note and drop it on SFTP; we can include a machine-readable XML/JSON sidecar manifest for auto-matching.

3) VAT fields: our UBL will include VAT breakdown per line (taxable_base, tax_amount) and we can add a custom boolean flag per line "vat_reclaimable" to match your reclaim rules.

Next steps / schedule proposal:
- Today: we push a sample UBL + CSV with po_issue_ts populated to the Redwood sandbox SFTP for your validation (ETA: tomorrow EOD UTC).
- Wed 31 Jul: run a joint validation with your AP (30 min) — confirm matching rules pass.
- After validation: we sign the enrollment DocuSign vendor form and move to production SFTP.

Attachments: po-timestamp-spec.csv (csv)

Let me know if SFTP credentials or a different delivery window is required. Happy to sync with your AP this week.

Best,
